layers.authority: Immigration management bodies and public security, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region
layers.process: People and vehicles entering or leaving a border management zone in Guangxi (areas along the Vietnam border that the state has published for special management) must carry valid papers and accept checks by immigration management bodies. Overseas residents who enter through a Guangxi border port and travel on to non-border areas must carry valid papers.

layers.authority: Immigration management bodies and public security, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region
layers.process: Approved surveying, scientific study, or film and television shooting within 2 kilometres of the national border must be reported to the local immigration management body and public security before it starts. Going onto a border river, lake or stream needs approval or filing with the relevant authority, and a report to public security before the activity.

laws.rule: Film or television shooting within 2 kilometres of the national border in Guangxi, even when approved, must be reported to immigration management and public security before it starts. Not reporting, or not following their directions: an order to correct, a warning, and a possible fine up to CNY 500 (about A$107). AUD at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026 (A$1 = CNY 4.6877).

In Guangxi border management zones it is prohibited to damage, remove or move boundary markers; to dig, farm or build in the border sight line (the cleared strip along the boundary); to open a road or track to the border line; or to cross the border to bury, cut trees, graze, farm or hunt. On border rivers, crossing the line to fish or transport, or mooring on the far side, is prohibited. Fine up to CNY 500 (about A$107) with a warning; serious cases CNY 500 to 5,000 (about A$107 to A$1,067). AUD at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026 (A$1 = CNY 4.6877).

Visitors must respect public order and manners, look after tourism facilities, resources and the environment, and not spit or urinate in the open, make noise, throw rubbish or scribble on sites. They must respect local customs, culture and religion, follow safety warnings, and cooperate with emergency measures (article 9).
laws.penalty_signal: No fine on the visitor is set in the article read; breaches fall under the other laws that apply.
